maintainer.identity: Merges the openai/math update pull requests; the update commits are authored by Dan Roberts <dr@openai.com>. The account had no public repositories when checked on 2026-10-27.
maintainer.follow: Follow on GitHub is an account action Christopher takes himself; the harness tracks the account's merges and authored commits in openai/math and its public repositories.

sources.license: Apache-2.0 (code, Lean and manuscripts as stated by the upstream README; check each artifact before reuse)
sources.status: Upstream manuscripts are model-produced. Unformalized results may contain errors; three were withdrawn on 2026-10-07. Treat every family as unverified until audited here.
